ValidationRule.description: Prevents users with the AE User, BDR User, or Inbound BDR profiles from reassigning an account that is owned by a user with the AM User or AM Director profile.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), OR( PRIORVALUE(Owner_Profile__c) = 'AM User', PRIORVALUE(Owner_Profile__c) = 'AM Director' ), OR( $Profile.Name = 'AE User', $Profile.Name = 'BDR User', $Profile.Name = 'Inbound BDR' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You may not reassign this account.
